   - We have weekly revenue figures and the closure date of Carrick Stowe (2026-03-27).
   - We also know that price-list changes for the West region did not occur until 2026-07-06, so April price changes are not a factor.

4. If it is, answer with what the data shows. If not, say what’s missing.
   - The data shows that West revenue fell in early April because the third depot (D12 Carrick Stowe) closed on 2026-03-27 and stopped contributing revenue from the week starting 2026-03-30 onward.
